query:
SELECT c.id, c.section_type, c.content, c.order_index 
FROM content_sections c
JOIN scraped_pages p ON c.page_id = p.id
WHERE p.job_id = 90005
ORDER BY c.page_id, c.order_index
LIMIT 20;
